context:
Item-specific guardrails: tuning must never change answers; no unregistered DDL rewrites.

Shared SereneDB guardrails: worktree-only repository writes with make agent-write-preflight; explicit-path staging, never git add -A; commit identity check, no attribution trailers; uv only, no new dependency; lazy psycopg import; no credentials in Git, logs, fixtures, or tracker; Mocker never in CI and its timings never published; pin by digest or exact version and record version(); announce long runs and never commit raw logs; code-skill self-review then make pr-preflight and make pr-open, no auto-merge without make pr-ready; durable artifacts carry no tracker IDs or session narrative; stop and report on failed gates, unverified behavior, or unapproved host changes.
description:
SereneDB rejects `ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT` / `ADD FOREIGN KEY` (upstream issue #206), and enforces inline FKs at load time. v1 declares no constraint tuning. Add PK/FK tuning when upstream supports adding constraints after load, or through inline DDL if load order and enforcement cost are acceptable.

Tasks:
1. Check upstream issue #206 and the current release notes.
2. Pick an approach: post-load ALTER (preferred once supported) or inline constraints with load in dependency order.
3. Register any DDL rewrite under Phase.DDL_OPTIMIZE, update `_supported_tuning_type_names`, and add tests.
4. Tuned and untuned runs both pass differential validation.

Decision gates:
- G1 Start only with explicit user priority.
- G2 If only inline constraints are possible and load time grows more than 2x, stop and report instead of shipping.
